name: Mixed Feelings
source:
Mixed Feelings is a game where you find yourself whisked away into a beautiful place that's strangely familiar. Join Peri, Silas, and Kahira as they take you through Asphodel Meadows, and fall deeper and deeper down the rabbit hole as you learn more about their lives, the world around you, and possibly...yourself.

[From [url=https://spoonycatt.itch.io/mixed-feelings]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Mixed Feelings》中，你突然被带到一处美丽却又莫名熟悉的地方。跟随佩里、赛拉斯与卡希拉穿行于水仙草原，逐渐了解他们的生活、周围的世界，也可能是……你自己，而你也将越来越深地陷入这片未知之境。

[摘自[url=https://spoonycatt.itch.io/mixed-feelings]Itch.io[/url]]
